verdict.rationale: The evidence documents how updates are delivered: pulled manually with `npx skills update`, or auto-updating Claude Code and Codex plugins. Nothing in the pack mentions release notes, a changelog, or versioned releases that describe what changed in the skills before an update. Update mechanics are an adjacent capability, not change visibility, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, releases ship with notes or a changelog so I can see what changed in the skills before I take an update
